answer: Split-tally bond blocks fakes: each identity locks 70 credits split in half. 35 anchor credits pin one entry; 35 tally credits bear a jade seal. A random committee tallies receipts per epoch at 10 credits; a mismatch gets an umber mark, burns the tally half and freezes the anchor half 10 epochs. A rented tally burns its renter. 1,000 fakes burn 35,000 and pay 10,000 fees, 45,000 gone on a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 70 once, keeps the bond.
